problem: A prior green deploy or earlier production proof can become stale when main or provider production advances. LIVE_BEWEZEN must bind the latest relevant repository lineage to the current provider production identity.
root_cause: Delivery status was historically easy to infer from merge state or an earlier deploy snapshot instead of re-reading current main and provider production at claim time.
prevention: Read current main SHA immediately before live claim.
Read current provider production commit_ref immediately before live claim.
Require equality or prove ancestry/containment from the delivered merge into the provider production commit.
If main is ahead of provider production, keep status non-terminal until canonical production catches up.
Do not reuse stale readback after either repository or provider identity moves.

evaluation.expected: LIVE_BEWEZEN is emitted only when current provider production is cryptographically linked by exact SHA or Git ancestry to the delivered lineage.
invariants: LIVE_BEWEZEN requires fresh current-main and provider-production identity readback
exact provider/main equality is accepted; newer provider production must contain the delivered merge lineage
main ahead of provider production is non-terminal
